name: giant toad
desc: Giant Toad is a CR 1 beast.

actions.name: amphibious
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can breathe air and water.

actions.name: standing leap
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s Long Jump is up to 20 feet and its High Jump is up to 10 feet with or without a running start.

actions.name: bite
actions.desc: [[/attack extended]]. [[/damage average extended]]. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the &Reference[Grappled apply=false] condition (escape DC [[lookup @skills.ath.passive]]).

actions.name: swallow
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} swallows a Medium or smaller target it is grappling. While swallowed, the target isn't Grappled but has the &Reference[Blinded apply=false] and &Reference[Restrained apply=false] conditions, and it has &Reference[Total Cover] against attacks and other effects outside the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}. In addition, the target takes [[/damage average]] damage at the end of each of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s turns. The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can have only one target swallowed at a time, and it can't use Bite while it has a swallowed target. If the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} dies, a swallowed creature is no longer Restrained and can escape from the corpse using 5 feet of movement, exiting with the &Reference[Prone apply=false] condition.
